description: This file defines the Flask Blueprint class and related setup state, including methods for registering routes, error handlers, template filters, and other application callbacks within a Flask application. It manages blueprint registration, nested blueprints, and deferred setup functions.

classes.name: Blueprint
classes.description: Represents a Flask blueprint, a collection of routes and functions that can be registered on an application later. Supports registration of routes, error handlers, template filters, and nested blueprints, with deferred setup functions.

classes.name: BlueprintSetupState
classes.description: A temporary holder object created during blueprint registration, containing references to the app, blueprint, options, and registration state. Provides methods to add URL rules and manage blueprint registration details.

methods.name: add_url_rule
methods.description: Registers a URL rule with the blueprint, prefixing it with the blueprint's URL prefix and endpoint name.

methods.name: app_template_filter
methods.description: Decorator to register a function as a global Jinja filter, available in all templates.

methods.name: add_app_template_filter
methods.description: Registers a function as a Jinja filter globally.

methods.name: app_template_test
methods.description: Decorator to register a function as a global Jinja test.

methods.name: add_app_template_test
methods.description: Registers a function as a Jinja test globally.

methods.name: app_template_global
methods.description: Decorator to register a function as a global variable in Jinja templates.

methods.name: add_app_template_global
methods.description: Registers a function as a global variable in Jinja templates.

methods.name: before_app_request
methods.description: Registers a function to run before each request, globally.

methods.name: after_app_request
methods.description: Registers a function to run after each request, globally.

methods.name: teardown_app_request
methods.description: Registers a function to run after each request for cleanup, globally.

methods.name: app_context_processor
methods.description: Registers a context processor for templates rendered by the application.

methods.name: app_errorhandler
methods.description: Decorator to register an error handler for all requests.

methods.name: app_url_value_preprocessor
methods.description: Decorator to register a URL value preprocessor for all requests.

methods.name: app_url_defaults
methods.description: Decorator to register default URL values for all requests.
